'''Sy Myrthians''' were the sentient natives of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Symyrthi.jpg|left|thumb|The New Republic Sy Myrthian diplomats with escort and pets.]]

Sy Myrthians were a species of apparently mammalian gastropods, moving on one large "foot" (similar to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]). They were covered in short fur and had elongated heads.

==History==
Once members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Sy Myrthians were represented by Senator [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], they seceded from the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Two later served as diplomats on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' erroneously describes Toonbuck Toora as a "hairy biped", even though all other sources specify that Sy Myrthians are not bipeds.

According to Leland Chee's "[[Ask Lobot]]" article in ''[[Star Wars Insider 101]]'', "There has been some suggestion that the Toonbuck Toora we see on Geonosis was actually a [[Shi'ido]] shape-shifter involved in a duplicitous ploy to bring Sy Myrth to the Confederacy. In that scenario, the plot is ultimately foiled, leaving the planet firmly loyal to the Republic."
